snippet.title: 「まさか、こんな幸運に恵まれるなんて!!」愛子さまがプラナカン博物館で突然足を止め、清掃スタッフと会話…その後の行動にシンガポールの記者が心を打たれた理由とは!?
snippet.description:
【創作ストーリー】愛子さまがプラナカン博物館で足を止めたとき、一人の清掃スタッフの人生が静かに交差します。
「まさか、こんな幸運に恵まれるなんて!!」――その言葉に込められた、本当の思いとは。
2026年11月18日、シンガポールを公式訪問中の愛子さまは、プラナカン博物館で多彩な文化や美術品をご覧になりました。鮮やかな青いワンピース姿で、鳥や花を表現した100万粒以上のビーズの作品を鑑賞されたことも報じられています。日本とシンガポールの外交関係樹立60周年という節目のご訪問です。
この実際の訪問を舞台に、もしも展示室を離れた廊下で、愛子さまが清掃スタッフのマヤと出会ったら――。本作は、そんな発想から生まれた心温まる物語です。
シングルマザーとして12歳の娘ヌリンを育てるマヤ。胸ポケットに入れていた青い鳥の絵をきっかけに、彼女は誰にも話せずにいた娘への願いを打ち明けます。
静かに耳を傾ける愛子さま。そして、小さなカードに託された言葉が、母娘の心に思いがけない変化をもたらしていきます。
華やかな舞台の陰で働く人々への敬意、母が子を思う気持ち、人に名前を呼んでもらうことの温かさ。
あなたは、愛子さまのどんな振る舞いに心を動かされるでしょうか。

snippet.title: 【興梠一郎氏に聞く】APECの論点と今後の日中関係／米中会談の注目点／米AI半導体迂回規制に中国はどう出る／AI投資ブームへの影響／NVIDIA問題を中国はどう見るか
snippet.description:
19日(木)12:00〜生配信は「APEC」をテーマに舞台になぜ「深圳」が選ばれたのか、史上初となる米中ロ3首脳会談の行方、そして米中半導体戦争の「第二幕」についてお届けします。神田外語大学教授の興梠一郎氏、第一生命経済研究所の西濵徹氏に伺いました。

＜ゲスト＞
西濵徹｜第一生命経済研究所 経済調査部 主席エコノミスト
一橋大学経済学部を卒業後、国際協力銀行（JBIC）を経て、2008年に第一生命経済研究所入社。アジアなど新興国のマクロ経済・政治分析を担当。参議院第一特別調查室客員調查員も経験。

興梠一郎｜神田外語大学教授
82年九州大学経済学部卒業、三菱商事入社。UCバークレー校、東京外国語大学大学院で修士号を取得。91年より神田外語大学で教鞭を執る傍ら、東大非常勤講師、外務省専門調査員（香港）、同省専門分析員、参議院参議院第１特別調査室客員調査員などを歴任。官民学の知見を融合。06年4月より現職。

snippet.title: 46 days lost at sea. One coconut.
snippet.description:
Forty-six days lost at sea. One coconut.

Robin Dejillo of Infanta, Quezon, says he lost the big boat he went out with in August 2024. He soaked his sweater in gasoline, lit it and held it up. Nobody came. Then his fuel ran out.

He had about a gallon of water. He sipped it and caught the rain. He says fish floated up beside the boat, and he ate some and dried the rest. In his own words, he found one coconut and ate the meat.

When the sharks circled, he says he let them be and went to sleep. Then the water and food ran out. He thought it was the end. That is when he saw a mountain.

Boatmen from Itbayat, in Batanes, spotted a boat that was not moving. It was not empty. He was more than six hundred kilometers from home, at the very top of the Philippines. A Coast Guard plane flew him to Manila, and he got home on his birthday.

Asked what he wanted to do first, he said, "Kain muna." Eat first. 🇵🇭

Sources: Philippine Coast Guard, GMA Network, Philippine News Agency

snippet.title: Blue Babe: The 36,000-Year-Old Bison Attacked by an Ice Age Lion! 🦬
snippet.description:
In 1979, gold miners near Fairbanks, Alaska, discovered the remarkably preserved remains of an Ice Age animal buried in permafrost.

Known as Blue Babe, this prehistoric steppe bison (Bison priscus) lived tens of thousands of years ago. Its body was so well preserved that scientists could still examine its skin, muscles, hooves and other soft tissues.

Researchers discovered deep bite marks, claw marks and even a fragment of a broken tooth embedded in its skin. These clues suggested that the bison had been attacked and scavenged by an extinct American lion.

Its unusual name comes from vivianite, a mineral that gives the remains their distinctive bluish appearance after exposure to air.

Today, Blue Babe is preserved at the University of Alaska Museum of the North, offering an extraordinary window into Ice Age life.

snippet.title: The entire family party went silent when Daniel saw the chain around his mother's neck.Margaret..
snippet.description:
The entire family party went silent when Daniel saw the chain around his mother's neck.

Margaret, nearly seventy, was sitting alone in the corner of the mansion courtyard while everyone else ate, drank, and pretended not to notice.

Vanessa stood over her holding the loose end of the decorative chain like it belonged there.

Margaret tried to stand.

Vanessa yanked it hard enough to force her back into the chair.

Then she kicked Margaret's plate away and said coldly,

"You eat when I say."

That was the moment Daniel came through the patio doors.

He didn't ask what was going on.

He saw his mother's face, saw the chain, saw the

guests staring-and something in him snapped.

Within seconds, the chain was off.
